commands.betterglass.bgwiki.faq.connecte: My Connected Textures don't work; why?
Did you make sure to install the "Continuity" mod and enable the provided "%s" resource pack? If yes, and it doesn't work, report the issue on the %s.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.faq.forced_t: Am I forced to use your textures for Vanilla Glass?
Currently, yes, but a toggle to switch back to Vanilla textures will be added in v1.2.0.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.faq.how_many: How many Glass Blocks are there?

As of v1.1.0, if you sum up all Glass Types, Patterns, Colors, and Stains for normal and tinted blocks and panes, you'll receive %s. If you count in Chiseled blocks (which are Creative-only), you'll reach %s!
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.faq.how_to_d: How am I supposed to deal with hundreds of different blocks and thousands of recipes!?

I recognize there are a lot of blocks and recipes; it is definitely quite overwhelming. But I have good news for you. Currently planned for v1.3.0 are two workstations to make crafting easier. Additionally, you can use the "JEI" mod for a comprehensive overview or run %s for a simplified list of recipes.

commands.betterglass.bgwiki.roadmap.intr: Better Glass has a roadmap for the future. This roadmap has no particular timeframe and is non-binding. These changes may never occur, occur in a different order, or only release in the 22nd century.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.root.introdu: This command is a small wiki on Better Glass. Run any of the below commands to read more!
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.types.availa: These are available in all possible combinations.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.types.behavi: There are Blocks, Panes, Tinted Blocks, and Tinted Panes. Tinted Glass does not let light through and darkens the area.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.types.chisel: There is also a Chiseled Glass variant to celebrate 500 downloads, which, as of v1.1.0, is Creative-only.
commands.betterglass.bgwiki.types.colora: There are two types of Coloration for Glass. Those are Stained (the entire block has a stain on it); and Colored (only opaque pixels are colored).
Additionally, there is "Patterned" Glass, which is Stained Glass but with a special motif instead of a color.

commands.betterglass.bgwiki.types.varian: Glass is available in Vanilla (using a vanilla-like texture), Scratched (using a texture resembling pre-1.14 Glass), and Clear (outline only).
